# Root edge chips vanish for descriptor-shaped center zones

## Context

Found during the #17863 journey-repair diagnosis (its engine-escalation clause routes the fix here). The `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL` park journey asserts the top edge chip's position against the app header — and the chip is not merely mispositioned, it is never offered: the parked candidate set arrives with `root: undefined`, so all four container edge chips stay `-off`. Reproduced with an in-spec diagnostic dump: `candidateSet.root: undefined, zone: 'scale-tabs'` while the cross indicators light normally.

## The Problem

`Neo.dashboard.dock.interaction.DragAffordances#ensureGeometry` resolves the chips' root target as:

```js
rootId = nodes[me.owner.dockModel.root]?.type === 'edge-zone'
    ? (nodes[me.owner.dockModel.root].zones?.center ?? me.owner.dockModel.root)
    : me.owner.dockModel.root;
```

In the current document schema an edge-zone's `zones.center` is a **descriptor object** (`{nodeId: 'split-main'}` in Workstation's committed document), not a bare node-id string — `Document.getZoneNodeId` exists precisely to unwrap both shapes, and the projection tier uses it everywhere. Here the raw descriptor flows into `geometry.root.nodeId`, and `PreviewProducer#produceCandidates` fail-closes on its type guard (`typeof root.nodeId === 'string'`) → `rootOut = null` → `DropIndicators` receives no `root.chips` → every edge chip keeps `neo-dashboard-dock-drop-indicator-off`.

Blast radius: every edge-zone-rooted consumer (Workstation, the cockpit) silently loses the dock-to-container-edge affordance family during drags. Split-rooted documents (the dashboard dock example, Demo-A) take the `: me.owner.dockModel.root` branch with a bare string and are unaffected — which is why the defect hid: the affordance demos kept working while the flagship lost its chips.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/DragAffordances.mjs` — the resolution site; imports `PreviewProducer` but not `Document`.
- `src/dashboard/dock/model/Document.mjs#getZoneNodeId` — the canonical object-descriptor reader (`{nodeId, …}`); the v13.2 contract **deliberately rejects the retired bare-string shorthand** (fail-closed `null`, no hidden compatibility reader — its own JSDoc states this). *(Corrected per PR #17867 review, 2026-08-29 — the original line claimed dual-shape support.)*
- `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/PreviewProducer.mjs#produceCandidates` — the fail-closed consumer whose guard converts the malformed id into silent chip absence. The guard is CORRECT; the producer's silence is the designed fail-closed posture.

## The Fix

Unwrap through the canonical helper at the resolution site:

```js
rootId = nodes[me.owner.dockModel.root]?.type === 'edge-zone'
    ? (Document.getZoneNodeId(nodes[me.owner.dockModel.root].zones?.center) ?? me.owner.dockModel.root)
    : me.owner.dockModel.root;
```

plus the `Document` import. Unit witness: a DragAffordances geometry test with an edge-zone document whose `center` is descriptor-shaped must produce a candidate set whose `root.nodeId` is the unwrapped string and whose `chips` carry all four edges — red against the current line by construction.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With an edge-zone root whose `center` zone is descriptor-shaped, the produced candidate set carries `root.nodeId` as the center node's id string and four edge chips.
- [ ] Split-rooted documents behave identically to today (no shape regression; the existing split-root tests prove the unchanged branch). The retired bare-string shorthand stays rejected — fail-closed `null` falls back to the document root, and no legacy compatibility reader is added. *(AC corrected per PR #17867 review, 2026-08-29.)*
- [ ] Unit-tier witness red against the unfixed line (mutation-checked).
- [ ] The `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL` park journey's top-chip guard executes again (validated in the #17863 lane; its AC converts from deferred-evidence once this merges).

## Out of Scope

- The journey spec itself (#17863 owns spec-tier repairs; its park test needs no change — it greens when chips return).
- Any indicator-menu visual/geometry change.

## Decision Record impact

none — restores the shipped affordance contract; no authority change.
